Enrich person.name: Paige Langston-Tedder
Enrich person.title: Director of Workforce Planning and Operations
Enrich person.summary:
Paige Langston-Tedder is an accomplished and dynamic leader with over 25 years of experience in driving operational excellence and leading high-performing teams. Her purpose is to make a positive difference in the lives of others, fostering an environment where individuals can experience happiness and feel success on their own terms. Known for her ability to solve complex problems and lead with empathy, Paige thrives in transforming challenges into opportunities that enhance efficiency, reduce expenses, and improve team performance.

Currently serving as the Director of Field Operations and Senior Vice President at Truist Financial Corporation, Paige oversees branch operations for a network of over 1,900 locations, managing a team of 325 employees. She plays a critical role in driving strategic goals, including risk mitigation and performance improvements. Paige’s expertise extends to managing high-risk transactions, incident responses, fraud events, and client escalations, all while fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability. 

Throughout her career, Paige has led successful re-organizations that streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency, consistently ensuring long-term success. She is particularly skilled at problem-solving in high-pressure situations, often taking the lead in cleanup efforts following significant operational setbacks. 

Paige is also passionate about supporting others in their personal and professional growth, demonstrating this commitment through her active volunteer work with the Panther Club, a local organization that supports student athletics at her local high school. Through this role, Paige helps ensure that student-athletes have the tools and resources they need to succeed both in the classroom and on the field.

Paige completed Banking School through Wake Forest University, further solidifying her expertise in the financial sector. With her commitment to excellence, her passion for helping others succeed, and her drive to make a meaningful impact, Paige continues to make a difference in both her personal and professional endeavors.
